fact_text: The IMF wants all government cash, including deposits of ministries, agencies and state-owned companies held at commercial banks, consolidated into one treasury single account, possibly at the State Bank.

fact_text: Netting government deposits held at banks against gross government debt gives a lower net debt figure, which is why the IMF wants the true net position shown.
